title: Getting your money back
body: How to request a refund for an order within 30 days.

title: How long reimbursements take
body: Most refund requests are processed in 5 to 7 business days.

title: Returning a damaged item
body: Start a return and choose refund or replacement.

title: Partial money back on bundles
body: Bundles qualify for a partial refund per item.

title: Cancelling before shipment
body: Orders cancelled before shipment get an automatic refund.

title: How to sign in to your account
body: Use your email address and password to sign in.

title: Trouble signing in
body: If you cannot sign in, reset your password from the sign in page.

title: Sign in with a passkey
body: Passkeys let you sign in without a password.

title: Two-step verification
body: Add a second step when you sign in from a new device.

title: Changing your email address
body: Update the email you use for notifications.

title: Tracking your shipment
body: Find the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email.

title: Shipping to a PO box
body: Some carriers cannot deliver to PO boxes.

title: International shipping rates
body: Rates depend on destination and package weight.

title: Express shipping cut-off times
body: Order before 2pm for same-day dispatch.

title: Downloading an invoice
body: Invoices are available from the orders page.

title: Updating a payment method
body: Add or remove cards from your wallet.

title: Gift cards and store credit
body: Store credit never expires and can be combined with cards.

title: Assembling a sofa frame
body: Attach the legs before fixing the back cushions.

title: Pairing wireless headphones
body: Hold the power button for five seconds to enter pairing mode.

title: Cleaning a cast-iron dutch oven
body: Avoid soap and dry immediately after rinsing.

title: Warranty coverage
body: Most products include a two year limited warranty.

title: Deleting your account
body: Account deletion is permanent after 14 days.

title: Exporting your data
body: Request a copy of your personal data from settings.

title: Contacting support
body: Chat support is available every day from 8am to 8pm.
